No UI, labels, readable text, characters, bars, borders or collage seams. Critical: landscape output, more environment on the left and right, original objects keep natural proportions. Preserve all four doors, their exact original placement within the central portrait, central terminal, open empty small cargo crate left of floor capsule hatch, and entire floor hatch. Added LEFT and RIGHT zones should be quiet believable continuations of the station hall: pipes, bulkheads, shallow shelves, low service cabinets, modest plants, tiled floor and ceiling. Only the original four clickable doors and original crate, no added doors or crates.
